description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Pyke''' [[File:Channeling icon.svg|20px|link=Channel|An icon representing the keyword Channel]] [[:Channel|charges]] while being [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowed]] by 20% for up to 3 seconds to increase ''Bone Skewer's'' [[File:Range icon.png|15px|link=Range]] range over the first second of the channel. ''Bone Skewer'' can be recast within the duration.
description.text: Active: Pyke charges while being slowed by 20% for up to 3 seconds to increase Bone Skewer's  range over the first second of the channel. Bone Skewer can be recast within the duration.

description2.raw: '''Recast:''' '''Pyke''' hurls his harpoon in the target direction, becoming [[File:Lockout icon 2.png|20px|link=Terminology#Lockout|An icon representing the keyword Lockout]] [[:Terminology#Lockout|unable to act]] while it is in flight and dealing physical damage to the first enemy hit and [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|pulling]] them, during which they are also [[File:Reveal icon.png|20px|link=Sight#Standard sight|An icon representing the keyword Standard sight]] [[:Sight#Standard sight|revealed]], then [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowing]] them by 90% for 1 second.
description2.text: Recast: Pyke hurls his harpoon in the target direction, becoming unable to act while it is in flight and dealing physical damage to the first enemy hit and pulling them, during which they are also revealed, then slowing them by 90% for 1 second.

description3.raw: Releasing the ability within 0.4 seconds causes '''Pyke''' to instead thrust his blade in the target direction, dealing the same damage to the closest enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]], or closest enemy otherwise.
description3.text: Releasing the ability within 0.4 seconds causes Pyke to instead thrust his blade in the target direction, dealing the same damage to the closest enemy champion, or closest enemy otherwise.

description4.raw: If the charge is [[File:Silence icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Disruption|An icon representing the keyword Interrupt]] [[:Crowd control#Disruption|interrupted]] or completes without reactivation, ''Bone Skewer'' is cancelled and the ability is put on [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] full cooldown but refunds [[File:Mana icon.svg|15px|link=Mana]] 75% of the mana cost. ''Bone Skewer's'' mana cost is also refunded if it hits an enemy champion.
description4.text: If the charge is interrupted or completes without reactivation, Bone Skewer is cancelled and the ability is put on  full cooldown but refunds  75% of the mana cost. Bone Skewer's mana cost is also refunded if it hits an enemy champion.

leveling2.raw:
'''Physical Damage:'''
100 / 150 / 200 / 250 / 300 (+ 75% '''bonus''' AD)
